User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the GrabZi application.

userId.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

locationLatitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the user's current location.

locationLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the user's current location.

totalDealsClaimed.description: The total number of deals claimed by the user.

totalFoodSaved.description: The total amount of food saved by the user (in kg).

rupeesSaved.description: The total amount of money (in rupees) saved by the user from claimed deals.

rank.description: The user's rank on the leaderboard.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor (restaurant, bakery, supermarket) offering deals on the GrabZi application.

vendorId.description: Unique identifier for the vendor entity.

businessName.description: The name of the vendor's business.

address.description: The address of the vendor's business.

contactInfo.description: The contact information for the vendor (e.g., phone number, email address).

activeDealsCount.description: The number of active deals currently offered by the vendor.

totalSales.description: The total sales generated by the vendor through the GrabZi application.

Deal.title: Deal
Deal.description: Represents a discounted food item or offer posted by a vendor on the GrabZi application.

dealId.description: Unique identifier for the deal entity.

title.description: The title of the deal (e.g., '30% off on Breakfast Combos').

price.description: The original price of the item before the discount.

discountPercent.description: The percentage discount offered on the item.

timeLeft.description: Timestamp indicating when the deal expires.

locationLatitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the deal's location.

locationLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the deal's location.

Puzzle.title: Puzzle
Puzzle.description: Represents an interactive mini-game or challenge that users must win to unlock a deal.

puzzleId.description: Unique identifier for the puzzle entity.

puzzleType.description: The type of puzzle (e.g., 'Tap-to-Catch', 'Food Match Puzzle', 'Trivia Spin Wheel').

data.description: Puzzle data (e.g., images, questions and answers).

difficultyLevel.description: The difficulty level of the puzzle.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a transaction made by a user to claim a deal.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the transaction entity.

paymentStatus.description: The payment status of the transaction.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the transaction occurred.

uniqueCode.description: Unique alphanumeric code generated after a successful deal claim (e.g., GZ-CHN-XXXXXX).

Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.description: Represents the leaderboard data for the GrabZi application.

userName.description: The user's name as displayed on the leaderboard.

totalPoints.description: The user's total points on the leaderboard.

rank.description: The user's rank on the leaderboard.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure prioritizes authorization independence and QAPs (Rules are not Filters). User data is stored under `/users/{userId}`. Deals are stored in a top-level `/deals` collection, with denormalized vendor information (businessName, location) to avoid `get()` calls in security rules and enable location-based queries. Each deal contains `vendorId` field. User-specific data (transactions/claimed deals) reside under `/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactionId}` to leverage path-based security. Leaderboard data is kept in a separate `/leaderboard/{userId}` collection for efficient querying. Puzzles are stored in a top-level `/puzzles/{puzzleId}` collection, with `puzzleId` being referenced in `/deals/{dealId}`. This approach allows for independently securing each collection and subcollection. QAPs are supported via structural segregation (deals are in their own collection) and denormalization (deal location is stored directly in the deal document to allow listing deals within a specific radius using geo queries).  Rupees saved information is stored on the User document to allow direct access.
